notes:
Summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS exploring Redwood as primary inference provider. Primary path: quick start on Hosted API to validate quality and latency, then move to Dedicated (VPC) for production. Security and procurement are gating the Dedicated purchase.

Top-level constraints and ask: p95 latency target ~ <400ms for short-chat flows, sustainable throughput ~ 40-60 rps during peak, cost sensitivity moderate — want guidance on batch/quantization tradeoffs. Must have Okta SSO + SAML for console/console access, KMS integration for customer-managed keys, and audit logs with 1 year retention or export capability. Data residency: US-only for customer data.

Recent call notes (sales/tech):
- 2026-02-18 demo w/ product + infra teams (Fireflies id above). Showed Hosted API for intent classification and embeddings. Product liked generation quality; infra wants latency numbers for p50/p95 with 2k tokens.
- Customer quote: "We need predictable tail latency for chat — p95 spikes are a dealbreaker".
- SE (Liam) proposed: start with Hosted POC for two weeks, run 1M tokens of mixed chat + embeddings, then carve out Dedicated VPC POC for a month.
- Security team requested SOC2 Type II report, SAML/SCIM support, exportable audit logs, retention controls and KMS/HSM integration.

POC scope and success metrics:
- Hosted POC (week 1-2): validate quality, integration friction, and basic cost run rate. Success = <5% regression on intent model metrics, no major integration blockers.
- Dedicated POC (week 3-6): provision Dedicated GPU pool in us-east, VPC peering + private control plane. Run 7-day ramp test: steady 50 rps with p95 <400ms, cost estimate for steady-state. Success = meeting latency SLOs and audit log collection verified.

Integration/technical notes (shorthand):
- Wants automatic fallback to smaller quantized model for heavy loads.
- Prefers open models (Redwood catalog) + ability to pin known model version.
- Needs IP allowlist + VPC peering details + NAT rules doc before engineering window.

Procurement/legal:
- Legal requested sample DPA, SOC2 report and insurance details. Finance asked for committed pricing/discount tiers for 12-month Dedicated.
- Blocker: SOC2 evidence must be in hand before final sign-off.

Links/references: pricing deck in Drive (above), initial technical architecture sketch shared via Gmail thread (id above). Jira ticket INF-7213 created for VPC peering constraints discussion.
